title: AD&D 2E Equipment Catalog

wealthCalculations.implementationNote: Keep catalog prices in their printed currency. For totals, convert cost.amount to copper using currencyConversionToCopper, multiply by inventory quantity, sum in copper, then format the result into PP/GP/EP/SP/CP. Character inventory should reference catalog item IDs instead of duplicating catalog records.

weightRules.tenPerPound: Ten items weigh one pound; represented as 0.1 lb per item.
weightRules.negligible: No appreciable weight; use zero for ordinary encumbrance unless a large quantity is carried.

implementationNotes: Weapons and ammunition are stored in weapons.json.
Armor, helmets, and shields are stored in armor.json.
Lodging, meals, animal care, and other services are stored in services.json.
Character-owned inventory belongs in equipment.json and references catalog IDs.
